# NetworkArchitectureSearch

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
Automated methods to discover efficient neural network topologies, including pruning, quantization, and neural architecture search, to reduce computation while maintaining accuracy. Provides a principled way to design compact, topology-optimized models that can be embedded in network devices or neuromorphic hardware with limited compute budgets.
